    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0273.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > /tmp/build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
rw=Chem.RWMol(); names=[]
def atom(el,name,charge=0,disable_h=False):
 a=Chem.Atom(el)
 a.SetFormalCharge(charge)
 if disable_h:a.SetNoImplicit(True)
 idx=rw.AddAtom(a);names.append(name);return idx
def bond(a,b,typ=Chem.BondType.SINGLE):rw.AddBond(a,b,typ)
ir=atom('Ir','Ir',disable_h=True)
p=[atom('C','P'+str(j)) for j in range(6)]
for j in range(6):bond(p[j],p[(j+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC);rw.GetAtomWithIdx(p[j]).SetIsAromatic(True);rw.GetAtomWithIdx(p[(j+1)%6]).SetIsAromatic(True)
for i in [1]:bond(ir,p[i]);rw.GetAtomWithIdx(p[i]).SetNoImplicit(True)
ls=[]
for tag,pidx in [('L',0),('R',2)]:
 m=atom('C',tag+'CH2');bond(p[pidx],m)
 nprox=atom('N',tag+'Nprox');bond(m,nprox)
 c1=atom('C',tag+'ringCH1');bond(nprox,c1)
 c2=atom('C',tag+'ringCH2');bond(c1,c2,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
 nmes=atom('N',tag+'Nmes');bond(c2,nmes)
 carb=atom('C',tag+'carbene',disable_h=True);bond(nmes,carb);bond(carb,nprox);bond(ir,carb)
 ls.append((nprox,nmes,carb))
 # mesityl: position 1 bound to N, methyl at 2,4,6
 ar=[atom('C',tag+'Mes'+str(j)) for j in range(6)]
 for j in range(6):bond(ar[j],ar[(j+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC);rw.GetAtomWithIdx(ar[j]).SetIsAromatic(True);rw.GetAtomWithIdx(ar[(j+1)%6]).SetIsAromatic(True)
 bond(nmes,ar[0])
 for j in [1,3,5]:bond(ar[j],atom('C',tag+'Me'+str(j)))
cl1=atom('Cl','ClFront');cl2=atom('Cl','ClBack');bond(ir,cl1);bond(ir,cl2)
m=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('SMILES', Chem.MolToSmiles(m), 'num atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(), 'heavy',len(names))
print('Ir index',ir,'carbenes', [x[2] for x in ls], 'aryl',p[1], 'Cl',cl1,cl2)
print('UFF params',AllChem.UFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m),'MMFF params',AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m))
for seed in [12,43,77,102]:
 x=Chem.Mol(m)
 rc=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(x,randomSeed=seed,maxAttempts=200, useRandomCoords=True)
 print(seed,'embed',rc,flush=True)
 if rc!=0:continue
 conf=x.GetConformer();xyz=np.array(conf.GetPositions()); print('ir lig dists',[(names[j],round(np.linalg.norm(xyz[ir]-xyz[j]),2)) for j in [p[1],ls[0][2],ls[1][2],cl1,cl2]])
 try:
  print('UFF opt',AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(x,maxIters=400),flush=True)
 except Exception as e:print('uff',e)
 xyz=np.array(x.GetConformer().GetPositions());print('ir lig dists post',[(names[j],round(np.linalg.norm(xyz[ir]-xyz[j]),2)) for j in [p[1],ls[0][2],ls[1][2],cl1,cl2]])
 Chem.MolToMolFile(x,f'seed{seed}.mol')
 with open(f'seed{seed}.xyz','w') as f:
  f.write(f'{x.GetNumAtoms()}\n{Chem.MolToSmiles(x)}\n')
  for a,q in zip(x.GetAtoms(),xyz):f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {q[0]:.9f} {q[1]:.9f} {q[2]:.9f}\n')
PY
